thread:
emily.design: New lightweight toast for model export complete (dark mode). Mock attached. Quick a11y check please — focus behavior, SR announce, contrast. CTA 'Download' + dismiss.

rana.a11y: If CTA is actionable, don't rely only on aria-live. Since export is user-triggered, moving focus to the primary button is OK. Save origin element and restore on close. Add sr-only prefix 'Notification:'.

kevin.frontend: Plan: auto-focus primary button when triggered by user, auto-dismiss 7s, Esc closes. Toast container tabindex=-1.

rana.a11y: Contrast: bg #141416 with text #eaeaea is ~4.1:1. Use #fafafa for body copy to meet 4.5:1. Ensure CTA label vs CTA bg also passes. Focus ring >=3:1.

alex.pm: Copy tweak: 'Export ready — Summaries v1' + CTA 'Download'. Keep SR hint 'Press Enter to open' as sr-only.

emily.design: I'll update Figma and add reduced-motion preference for animations. Kevin pls add unit test for focus restore and an axe contrast check in CI.

kevin.frontend: Will do. Pushing branch feat/toast-export-a11y and will ping when PR is up. :shipit:
